bind_address.description: IP address to bind the SMTP listener to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' or '::'). Set to empty or omit to bind to all interfaces.

smtp_port.description: TCP port to listen on for incoming SMTP connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of concurrent SMTP connections accepted.

connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for establishing and maintaining an SMTP connection.

items.description: Network in CIDR notation (e.g., '192.168.1.0/24') or hostname allowed to relay without authentication.

relay_nets.description: List of trusted networks permitted to send mail via this DMA instance.

items.description: A domain (e.g., 'example.com') whose mail should be delivered locally.

local_domains.description: Domains for which this host acts as the final destination.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for incoming SMTP connections (requires valid cert/key files).

tls_cert.description: Path to TLS certificate in PEM format (public part).

tls_key.description: Path to TLS private key in PEM format (must be readable only by dma).

tls_ciphers.description: OpenSSL-style cipher list to restrict allowed TLS ciphers. Leave empty to use system defaults.

require_starttls.description: Reject SMTP connections that do not negotiate STARTTLS.

opportunistic_tls.description: Use STARTTLS opportunistically when delivering outbound mail (if the remote server supports it).

smtp_auth_method.description: Authentication mechanism accepted for SMTP AUTH (case-sensitive).

smtp_auth_file.description: Path to the file containing SMTP-authenticated users (sendmail-style passwd format).

max_message_size.description: Maximum allowed message size in bytes (0 = unlimited). Recommended: 10MB (10485760).

default_sender.description: Envelope sender address to use when local programs send mail without specifying one (e.g., 'noreply@example.com').

queue_dir.description: Directory where pending deliveries are queued.

delivery_workers.description: Number of parallel worker processes to deliver queued mail.

retry_interval.description: Time (seconds) between retry attempts for temporarily failed deliveries.

max_retries.description: Number of delivery attempts before giving up and bouncing the message.

verbose_logging.description: Enable detailed logging of SMTP transactions and connection details.

use_syslog.description: Log to the system syslog instead of to a dedicated log file.

log_file.description: Log file path (used only if syslog logging is disabled).

max_log_size.description: Maximum size (bytes) before log rotation (0 = no rotation).

log_rotate_count.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

rewrite_sender.description: Header field to rewrite (e.g., 'Return-Path') with the envelope sender — typically leave blank for default behavior.

alias_file.description: Path to the sendmail-style alias database file (used for local delivery mapping).

delivery_mode.description: Delivery strategy: 'mda' for local delivery (via MDA) or 'relay' to forward all mail to another SMTP server.

relay_host.description: Hostname (and optional port) of the upstream relay (e.g., 'smtp.example.com:587'). Required for DeliveryMode=relay.

relay_user.description: Username for authenticating to the upstream relay (if required).

relay_pass.description: Password for the relay user. Store securely (file mode 600).

relay_tls.description: Enable TLS when connecting to the relay host (common for submission port 587).
